sentences.en: Stephanie, this is so cool.

sentences.zh: 我记得有一次看到我们的杆式话筒员尼克·卡尔博尼，他因为在笑，拿着话筒的手都在抖。

sentences.en: His, like, shoulders were going, and I was like, yes!
sentences.zh: 他的肩膀一耸一耸的，当时我就想，太棒了！

sentences.en: But yeah.
sentences.zh: 不过是的。

sentences.en: Well, Craig, thank you so much for your question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，克雷グ，非常感谢你的提问。

sentences.en: It definitely brought a smile to my face remembering all of that.
sentences.zh: 想起这一切，确实让我脸上露出了笑容。

sentences.en: But I guess our answer is the directors usually had to rein us in, and every once in a while, Oscar, under his breath, would be like, come on, guys.
sentences.zh: 但我想我们的答案是，通常导演不得不把我们管束住，而且偶尔，奥斯卡会压低声音说，行了，伙计们。

sentences.en: And maybe Kelly Cantley could get us to pull it together, right?
sentences.zh: 也许凯利·坎特利能让我们收敛一点，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Or AD.
sentences.zh: 或者助理导演。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Maybe Kelly.
sentences.zh: 也许是凯利。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: She would sometimes come in and be like, guys, do we want to make it to lunch?
sentences.zh: 她有时会走过来对我们说，伙计们，我们还想不想吃午饭了？

sentences.en: Let's make it.
sentences.zh: 加把劲吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Bring up food, and that could get us to become serious.
sentences.zh: 提一下食物，这就能让我们变得严肃起来。

sentences.en: Lady, do you remember early on, before Nick Carbone joined us, and it might have even been someone who was just on set as, like, an extra set of hands, there was a boom operator.
sentences.zh: 女士，你还记得早期吗？在尼克·卡尔博尼加入我们之前，甚至可能只是某个在片场搭把手的人，当时有个杆式话筒员。

sentences.en: And we were laughing, and he got really annoyed with us.
sentences.zh: 我们在笑，他变得非常生我们的气。

sentences.en: Do you remember that?
sentences.zh: 你还记得吗？

sentences.en: It was in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 那是在厨房里。

sentences.en: We were in the kitchen, and I think I'm thinking of the episode, but I don't want to say what it is.
sentences.zh: 我们在厨房里，我想我记得是哪一集，但我不想说出来是哪集。

sentences.en: And we were all busting up laughing, and he got super annoyed, and I thought, man, this is not the job for you.
sentences.zh: 我们当时都笑得前俯后仰，他超级生气，当时我想，天哪，这工作真不适合你。

sentences.en: Like, this is part of it.
sentences.zh: 这本来就是工作的一部分。

sentences.en: Like, we're making comedy here.
sentences.zh: 就好像，我们在拍喜剧。

sentences.en: We're going to break sometimes, and that's part of the energy.
sentences.zh: 我们有时会笑场，这也是那种氛围的一部分。

sentences.en: And I think he didn't find the show as funny as the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他觉得这节目没我们其他人觉得那么好笑。

sentences.en: I don't think he thought it was funny.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他觉得这并不好笑。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我觉得是的。

sentences.en: I remember him.
sentences.zh: 我记得他。

sentences.en: But, yeah, our show wasn't for him.
sentences.zh: 不过，也是，我们的节目不适合他。

sentences.en: It wasn't.
sentences.zh: 确实不适合。

sentences.en: He needed to be on a drama, something more serious.
sentences.zh: 他需要去演正剧，一些更严肃的剧。

sentences.en: A procedural, yeah.
sentences.zh: 律政或刑侦剧吧，对。

sentences.en: He wasn't loving it.
sentences.zh: 他并不怎么享受。

sentences.en: But listen, I mean, that comes with the territory on a comedy.
sentences.zh: 但听着，我的意思是，拍喜剧就是这样的。

sentences.en: I feel like that's something that I learned, too, is that the atmosphere of making a comedy is comedic.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这也是我学到的一点，那就是拍喜剧的氛围本身就是喜剧性的。

sentences.en: And if you get too serious or you're just constantly looking at the clock and you're, like, wondering when are we going to get this shot, like,
sentences.zh: 如果你变得太严肃，或者总是在看表，然后，比如说，在想我们什么时候能拍完这个镜头，就像是，

sentences.en: that's actually a hard role for our first ADs, for Kelly and for Rusty, because they have to leave time for the levity on set to keep the comedy ball in the air.
sentences.zh: 这对我们的第一副导演凯莉和拉斯蒂来说其实是个很难的角色，因为他们必须留出时间让片场保持轻松，好让喜剧的节奏持续下去。

sentences.en: But you also have to make sure you're getting the shot and that we're breaking in time for lunch and all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 但你同时也得确保拍到了镜头，确保我们能在午饭前收工之类的各种事情。

sentences.en: And so we were really lucky with Kelly and Rusty because they let us have fun, but they were pretty good at, like, reining us in when they needed to as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在凯莉和拉斯蒂身上真的很幸运，因为他们让我们玩得很开心，但在需要的时候，他们也很擅长把我们拉回正轨。

sentences.en: Yeah, they were like your fun aunt and uncle, you know, that let you, like, just let loose.
sentences.zh: 对，他们就像是你有趣的叔叔阿姨，你知道的，就让你彻底放松。

sentences.en: But then it was like, all right, guys, come on.
sentences.zh: 但接着就会像是，好了，各位，来吧。

sentences.en: Let's go.
sentences.zh: 我们走。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You can't stay up too late.
sentences.zh: 你们不能熬夜太晚。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Some of the times I laughed so hard, too, was just in the pauses.
sentences.zh: 有时我笑得最厉害的时候，其实是在停顿的间隙。

sentences.en: I don't know if you remember that, Jenna, but there were so many times when we were in a conference room and Steve as Michael would start improvising.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你还记不记得，珍娜，但有太多次我们在会议室里，史蒂夫饰演的迈克尔会开始即兴发挥。

sentences.en: So we didn't know what he was about to say.
sentences.zh: 所以我们根本不知道他接下来要说什么。

sentences.en: We'd already gotten the scene scripted many times.
sentences.zh: 剧本上的戏我们已经拍过很多遍了。

sentences.en: And then there'd be one or two moments where Steve as Michael would have a list of things he had to say and he would start improvising that liSt.
sentences.zh: 然后会有一两个时刻，史蒂夫饰演的迈克尔会有一串他必须说的话，接着他就会开始即兴发挥那一长串内容。

sentences.en: And it was the pause before he said the next thing where I would come undone.
sentences.zh: 就是他在说下一句之前的那段停顿，让我彻底破防了。

sentences.en: The excitement of what he was going to say was so thrilling to me.
sentences.zh: 对他说出口的话的期待让我感到无比兴奋。

sentences.en: And then inevitably, whatever he said would be ridiculously funny.
sentences.zh: 然后不可避免地，他说出的任何话都会荒谬地好笑。

sentences.en: But it was the pause that got me, like, his long, like, I'm like, oh, my God, I'm out.
sentences.zh: 但真正击中我的是那个停顿，比如他长长的，我就想，天哪，我不行了。

sentences.en: I'm out.
sentences.zh: 我彻底笑趴了。

sentences.en: All of this reminiscing about this is just, gosh, we laughed a lot.
sentences.zh: 所有这些回忆，天哪，我们以前真的笑得太多了。

sentences.en: What a gift that our job was to go somewhere and be around funny people being funny.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作居然是去某个地方，和一群搞笑的人在一起搞笑，这真是上帝的恩赐。

sentences.en: There's just nothing like it.
sentences.zh: 简直无与伦比。

sentences.en: Truly.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: We're really lucky.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很幸运。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Oh, you guys, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 哦，伙计们，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We hope you enjoyed this episode.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你们喜欢这一集。

sentences.en: Big thank you to Joel McHale for spending the afternoon with us, being silly.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢乔尔·麦克海尔和我们度过了一个下午，陪我们一起搞笑。

sentences.en: And thank you to everyone who sends in their chit-chats and around the towns.
sentences.zh: 也要感谢所有发来闲聊和周边趣闻的每一个人。

sentences.en: We love hearing from you guys so much.
sentences.zh: 我们非常喜欢听到你们的分享。

sentences.en: We appreciate this community so very much.
sentences.zh: 我们极其感激这个社区。

sentences.en: And just in case these kittens are still in my house, everybody, please go to kittenrescue.org and adopt my kittens.
sentences.zh: 以防万一这些小猫还在我家里，各位，请去 kittenrescue.org 领养我的小猫吧。

sentences.en: Yes, adoption of sweet kittens.
sentences.zh: 没错，收养可爱的小猫咪。

sentences.en: All right, you guys, have a great week.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，祝你们度过愉快的一周。

sentences.en: We'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 我们下期再见。

sentences.en: See you then.
sentences.zh: 到时候见。

sentences.zh: 感谢收听《办公室女士》。
